main.description: The asking account's dev.knotless.profile record, as its settings show it: only what it set on knotless, with nothing of its Bluesky profile, which stands in for each field left out (dev.knotless.getProfile shows the two together). Requires authentication: a service token, or the session cookie the pages' login sets.

ownProfile.description: What an account's knotless profile holds. A field it left out is absent.

avatar.description: Where this appview serves the account's picture.

bot.description: Whether the account says it is a bot. Absent when it is not.

description.description: Free text about the account: its bio.

displayName.description: The name shown over the account's handle.

links.description: Links shown on the profile, in display order.

description: The asking account's knotless profile, as it set it.
